critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 4217 lines — should be split into focused routers (auth, families, missions, home, avatar, sparks, games, moments, etc). Becoming a maintenance hazard.

_generate_spark falls back to 4 static lines if Claude is unreachable — good resilience, but on failure the static fallback is still upserted into db.home_sparks so the family is stuck with a static line for 24h. Consider NOT caching when fallback is used.

AVATAR_COLOR_PALETTE 'amber' gradient (from-#FFD166 to-#EF476F) is identical to 'pink' reversed — visually nearly identical color choices for kids. Consider differentiating amber more (e.g., yellow→orange).
GET /api/home/{slug} loops over students and awaits _compute_streak sequentially — N+1 latency pattern. With many kids this gets slow. Use asyncio.gather().
Avatar emoji palette grid uses 'grid-cols-8' fixed — with 24 emojis + initial = 25 buttons, last row has only 1 button. Minor aesthetic.
